message.time_heals.need_full_stack: A full stack of Time Crystals (64) is required
death.attack.temporal_backlash: You were lost in the explosion caused by Temporal Backlash
advancements.time_heals.bankruptcy.title: Bankruptcy
advancements.time_heals.bankruptcy.descr: Looking at that pile of Draconic materials and two bows in the fusion core, are you sure you still want to press it?
advancements.time_heals.mutual_destructi: You won the fight, but your own machine took you with it. The Chaos Dragon sends its congratulations from the void.
advancements.time_heals.godslayer.title: Mortal Iron Slays a God
advancements.time_heals.godslayer.descri: A sword with iron-tier stats dealt 50000 chaotic damage. Time Sword: worth it.
advancements.time_heals.who_is_crying.de: The machine vanished, leaving only a block of obsidian. Why is it crying? Because you just sent a Draconic Staff into the incinerator.
advancements.time_heals.recycling.title: Recycling Scrap
advancements.time_heals.recycling.descri: Even a Draconic relic, worn down by time, can only be recycled as scrap.
